title: [3rd Party Tech Note] A Practical Approach To Record Locking and Data Entry
author: Dave Terry, Pacific Data Management, Inc.
featured_technology: Hybrid locking strategy for data entry UX

historical_commentary.text: This note's core subject — pessimistic vs. optimistic record locking and a hybrid UX-friendly strategy — describes concepts that remain fundamentally valid, but 4D's own locking model changed significantly with ORDA, which added true optimistic entity locking as a first-class, built-in mechanism rather than something developers had to hand-roll on top of classic pessimistic locks.
related_updates: ORDA optimistic entity locking (built-in `.save()` conflict detection, v16 R5+) natively provides much of what this hybrid approach worked around manually
Classic pessimistic `READ WRITE`/lock commands remain available for non-ORDA classic-form apps
